scope: Six fixed warm-identity create/remove cycles, user-controlled LG disconnect/reconnect. No capture, AX/input, profile deletion, daemon restart or main App restart.
limitations: Sequential single-machine experiment, not randomized; unrelated system workloads uncontrolled.
Six cycles reproduced persistent additional ColorSync work, not the historical severe stutter.
ICC hashes cover matched OCU files, not all ColorSync caches/registry.
Physical disconnect changes topology and display state together; internal trigger/caller not established.
outcome: Persistent additional ColorSync work reproduced after six warm cycles; disappeared on LG disconnect and remained near baseline after reconnect. Historical severe stutter not reproduced.
